description: Defines the RandomTreeTrainer class for training decision tree classifiers/regressors using random split points, including methods for constructing splits, training models, and handling feature types within a media learning context.

classes.name: RandomTreeTrainer
classes.description: A class for training random decision trees with support for numeric and nominal features, utilizing random split points for extra trees.

classes.name: Split
classes.description: Represents a proposed split in the decision tree, including split index, split point, target distribution, and branch information.

classes.name: BranchInfo
classes.description: Contains information about training data indices and target histograms for each branch of a split.

methods.name: RandomTreeTrainer
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the trainer with an optional random number generator.

methods.name: Train
methods.description: Trains a model on the provided learning task and data, invoking a callback with the trained model.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Recursively builds a decision tree node from training data and used feature set.

methods.name: ConstructSplit
methods.description: Constructs a split for a specific feature index based on training data.

methods.name: ComputeSplitScore_Nominal
methods.description: Calculates the score for a nominal feature split.

methods.name: ComputeSplitScore_Numeric
methods.description: Calculates the score for a numeric feature split.

methods.name: FindSplitPoint_Nominal
methods.description: Determines the split point for a nominal feature.

methods.name: FindSplitPoint_Numeric
methods.description: Determines the split point for a numeric feature.
